source.title: Convex Optimization
source.edition_note: 2004; seventh printing with corrections 2009, as identified in the downloaded PDF

scope_definition.required: Exercises explicitly requiring a numerical algorithm run, implementation, generated-instance testing, or numerical experimentation.
scope_definition.optional: Explicit visual deliverables, concrete-data analytical fixtures, and algorithm/complexity derivations that are reasonable numerical extensions; these are not required machine exercises. Optional entries are a conservative borderline catalogue, not a claim that all other mathematical problems lack numerical applications.
scope_definition.excluded: Pure proofs and abstract reformulations without an explicit computational/graphical task; separate additional exercises; reproducing worked examples.
scope_definition.selected_delivery: All 11 strictly required exercises plus planned extras 4.3, 5.29, 5.33, 5.34, and 11.1; sixteen selected modules total.

method: Every end-of-chapter exercise was read in the official PDF text, with an independent second scan of Chapters4-8 for execution, data, verification, and plotting language. Exercise IDs were extracted and checked against complete sequential chapter ranges. Numeric matrices for the planned Chapter5 extras were also visually checked in rendered PDF pages.
